# Five Star Daily

> Unofficial fan site about Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6). Live streams, new videos, daily news with our own summaries, guides in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

## Guides
- [GTA 6 is out: release date, editions and platforms](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/release-date/): GTA 6 launched November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Release date, platforms, file size and what is confirmed.
- [How to pre-load GTA 6, and how much space you need](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/pre-load/): Pre-loading is open on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here is how to get the game installed before launch night.
- [Every official GTA 6 trailer, in order](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/trailers/): Four official videos from Rockstar, from the first reveal to the launch trailer. Watch them all right here.
- [Leonida's six confirmed regions, explained](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/leonida-regions/): Rockstar has named six places in its Florida-inspired state. Here is what each one is like.
- [GTA 6 gameplay: everything the 30-minute Extended Look showed](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/gameplay-extended-look/): On August 27, Rockstar finally showed long, uncut gameplay on Netflix. Here is what it taught us about how GTA 6 plays.
- [Jason and Lucia: who they are and how switching works](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/jason-and-lucia/): GTA 6 has two leads who are a couple. Here is what Rockstar has said about them and about playing as both.
- [Every confirmed GTA 6 character so far](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/characters/): Beyond Jason and Lucia, Rockstar has introduced a cast of bosses, friends, artists and influencers. Here is who is who.
- [How police and the wanted system work in GTA 6](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/wanted-system/): The stars are back, but escaping the cops works differently now. Here is what has been shown.
- [GTA 6 combat, weapons and stealing cars: what changed](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/combat-and-cars/): Non-lethal takedowns, branded guns, lock-picking and key-fob cloning. A look at the action side of GTA 6.
- [Things to do in Leonida: every side activity shown so far](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/things-to-do/): Fishing, airboats, basketball, the gym and a lot more. Everything Rockstar has shown you can do when you are not on a job.
- [GTA 6 references and callbacks to older GTA games](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/references-and-callbacks/): Vice City is back, and so are a few old friends. The nods to the series we have spotted in official footage.
- [The road to GTA 6: a timeline from announcement to launch](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/timeline/): Two trailers, two delays and one Netflix special. Every official milestone on the way to November 19, 2026.
- [GTA 6 songs: full soundtrack and radio stations list (play them here)](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/soundtrack/): Every GTA 6 song on the official album, plus the radio stations. Play the full playlist on Spotify right here, no login needed for previews.
- [GTA 6 Standard vs Ultimate Edition: price, bonuses and which to buy](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/editions/): Two editions, a box with no disc and a pre-order bonus with a deadline. Everything confirmed about buying GTA 6, in one page.
- [GTA 6 confirmed cars, weapons, clothes and shops (official only)](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/cars-weapons-shops/): Every car, gun and place Rockstar has actually named or shown, separated from the guesses. Leaks are left out.
- [GTA 6 cheat codes: what is known and which lists to ignore](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/cheats/): Lists of GTA 6 cheat codes are going around. Here is what the early reports actually say, and what is still unverified.
- [GTA 6 missions list: all 5 chapters and 91 story missions in order](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/missions/): Every chapter and story mission in order, with a spoiler fold so you only open what you want.
- [GTA 6 collectibles: what exists and where the first ones were found](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/collectibles/): The collectible types in GTA 6, the totals the 100% menu asks for, and place names where players have already found some.
- [GTA 6 radio stations: all 22 stations and every song by station](https://fivestardaily.com/guides/radio-stations/): Every station, its genre and hosts, and the full song list for each one.
